Trying to make a baby laugh should not be this competitive.

A baby has a very specific sense of humor, and unfortunately one guy is taking that extremely personally. Things escalate from weird noises and dangling keys to bad jokes, dirty comedy, and a minor crisis of confidence.

Turns out babies are tough crowds.
